@pytest.mark.parametrize('source, task_vars, expected', [
    (b'#"'!/opt/venv/bin/python3.8 -I'"\\nimport ansible.module_utils.basic\\n', {}, b'#"'!/opt/venv/bin/python3.8 -I'"'),
    (b'#"'!/opt/venv/bin/python3.8 -I'"\\nimport ansible.module_utils.basic\\n',
     {'ansible_python_interpreter': '/usr/bin/python3'}, b'#"'!/usr/bin/python3 -I'"'),
    (b'import ansible.module_utils.basic\\n', {}, b'#"'!/usr/bin/python'"'),
])
def test_new_style_python_wrapper_uses_module_shebang(tmp_path, templar, source, task_vars, expected):
    module = tmp_path / 'shebang_module.py'
    module.write_bytes(source)
    data, style, shebang = modify_module('shebang_module', str(module), {}, templar, task_vars=task_vars)
    assert style == 'new'
    assert data.splitlines()[0] == expected
    assert data.splitlines()[1] == b'# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-'
    assert shebang == expected.decode()


@pytest.mark.parametrize('source, task_vars, expected', [

    (b'#"'!/usr/bin/ruby -w'"\\nputs 1\\n', {'ansible_ruby_interpreter': '/opt/ruby/bin/ruby'}, b'#"'!/opt/ruby/bin/ruby -w'"'),
    (b'print(1)\\n', {}, b'#"'!/usr/bin/python'"'),
])
def test_old_style_module_resolves_shebang(tmp_path, templar, source, task_vars, expected):

    assert data.splitlines()[1] == b'# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-'
    assert shebang == expected.decode()
